title: 深海潜水艇
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Scene: A large cheerful submarine greets ONE friendly big fish, both in a playfully tilted pose with simple solid-black eyes and OPEN curved smile strokes, no enclosed mouths or tongues. The submarine is one broad organic bean-shaped body with TWO huge single-line portholes, ONE broad tailfin joined directly to the body without a collar or stripe, and ONE broad simple lower fin. An extra-wide curved periscope grows directly from the body, all one shape, NO top dome/tower, NO base stripe, NO end-cap ellipse. The fish is one broad body with one broad tail and one large side fin, no scales, no stripes and no little dorsal fins. Strictly empty white background, NO ground/sea line, NO bubbles, no plants. All contours have generous width, and no narrow trapped pockets where fins join the body. Use only 8–12 large closed white coloring shapes total including background; maximum 16. Every enclosed white shape fits a circle of at least 6 percent of image width. Simple expert illustrated contours, happy storytelling, not a machine diagram.

EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE ONLY. Preserve the friendly submarine, its playful tilt, one fish friend, fins, periscope and existing professional curves exactly. Simplify BOTH portholes: keep only each LARGE OUTER oval outline and completely erase its INNER oval, leaving a large plain white window bounded by a single oval, no white ring. Make BOTH submarine eyes completely solid BLACK ovals by filling the narrow white crescent inside each eye; no eye white anywhere. Make the fish eye solid black as well if there is any enclosed white sliver. Do not change mouth smiles or add any objects. No new shapes or rings, pure black line art on pure white.
visualReview: Accepted after inspecting both original PNG and all numbered region masks: expressive simple professional line art; major subject areas closed and separate from background; no narrow mechanical rings or omitted excess regions.
